judge.rationale: The candidate accurately implements usage accumulation across tool rounds, handles missing per-round usage without NaN or undefined poisoning, and satisfies all acceptance criteria including spec and CHANGELOG updates. To make the hook contract unambiguous, it introduces an exported `AggregateUsageMetadata` type alias on `afterModelResponse` whereas the reference renames the parameter to `totalUsage` and syncs the doc-blocks in `CLAUDE.md` and `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`. In `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate leaves the updated `afterModelResponse` bullets inside the `Measured semantics — out of scope` section instead of promoting the new behavior into the main spec section like the reference did. Additionally, the candidate creates a separate acceptance test file, modifies an existing test in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` rather than keeping it and adding new tests alongside it, and leaves `.lore/dod.md` in the diff.
